name: s3eidat-tools
description: Free, private PDF, image, text, developer, calculator and QR tools. Runs on your computer; files are never uploaded.
long_description:
The tools from [s3eidat.github.io](https://s3eidat.github.io/) for Claude: merge, split, compress, watermark, number, sign and fill PDFs; PDF to text or images; convert, resize, compress and clean images (EXIF/GPS); word counts, case, Arabic text tools, numbers to words; JSON/CSV/YAML/XML/SQL formatting; hashes, Base64, JWT, regex, cron; loan, zakat, GPA, date and unit calculators; prayer times; passwords and website-compatible encryption; QR codes and barcodes; invoices, receipts, labels, calendars and CVs as PDF.

Everything runs locally: no account, no API key, no telemetry.

root.title: Allowed folder (optional)
root.description: If set, the tools can only read and write files inside this folder.

out_dir.title: Output folder (optional)
out_dir.description: Where results go when you don't say where to save them. Default: a temporary folder.

groups.title: Tool groups (optional)
groups.description: Comma-separated groups to load, e.g. pdf,image,text. Empty = all: pdf, image, text, data, dev, calc, everyday, qr, docs, ai.

compact.title: Compact mode
compact.description: Show Claude 3 small search/run tools instead of every tool (saves context; Claude finds tools as needed).
